117961.name: Southern Connecticut Hebrew Academy
117961.note: The Chinuch Office directory of Chabad schools (2023-24): Southern Connecticut Hebrew Academy-Elementary, 261 Derby Ave., Orange, 'Elementary Founded: 1945' (its preschool 'Founded: 1950'). COLlive (10 March 2026): 'For nearly 80 years, Yeshivas Achei Temimim Lubavitch – Southern Connecticut Hebrew Academy has been more than a school'. New Haven Register (on CrownHeights.info, 24 Dec 2007): Rabbi Moshe Yitzchok Hecht 'founded the New Haven Hebrew Day School in the 1940s beginning with a few students'. Medium: Rebbetzin Rivkah Hecht 'arrived in New Haven in 1946 with her husband' (CrownHeights.info, 15 July 2010).

120114.name: Camp Gan Israel
120114.note: No start date found: Camp Gan Israel of the Southern Connecticut Hebrew Academy campus in Orange (Mrs. Chanie Wilhelm). Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then.

117583.name: Rabbinical Institute of New Haven
117583.note: No start date found yet: the Rabbinical Institute of New Haven (the Lubavitch yeshiva gedolah, Rabbi Yitzchok Kalmenson), 300 Norton Street. Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then.

2856583.name: Colel Tiferes Zekainim
2856583.note: No start date found: Colel Tiferes Zekainim (Rabbi Berel Levitin), 296 Norton Street. Its chabad.org listing went up Feb 10 2015, so it existed by then.

118203.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Hamden
118203.note: No start date found yet: Rabbi Moshe Hecht's Chabad Jewish Center of Hamden (jewishhamden.org). Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then.

118249.name: Chabad at Yale University
118249.note: Jewish Ledger (9 March 2011): 'Rabbi Shua and Sara Rosenstein started Chabad at Yale in 2002', then in a house on Edgewood Avenue. Rabbi Meir Chaim Posner is on the listing now.

118331.name: Chabad of the Shoreline
118331.note: No start date found yet: Rabbi Yossi Yaffe's Chabad of the Shoreline, Guilford (2710 Boston Post Road; neighbors fought its building plan in 2008, COLlive). Its yearly Shoreline Jewish Festival began in 2006 (the 14th was in 2019, Jewish Ledger). Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then.

120111.name: Lubavitch Mikvah
120111.note: No start date found: the Lubavitch mikvah in New Haven (no address on the listing; not the communal New Haven Mikvah Society on Hubinger Street). Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then.

120112.name: Yeshivas Beis Dovid Shlomo
120112.note: New Haven Independent (11 Jan 2019): 'The yeshiva's website says that the high school, which was founded in 1976 in the home of Reb Dovid & Sara Deitsch, now serves over 150 students'; 'In 2007, the yeshiva spent $900,000 on a 13,000-plus square-foot property at 292 Norton St.' Its mesivta is at 342 Ellsworth Ave (Chinuch Office directory, 2023-24).

earlier.where: the home of Reb Dovid and Sara Deitsch

326613.name: Chabad of Wallingford
326613.note: Record-Journal (on CrownHeights.info, 18 Dec 2005): Rabbi Baruch Kaplan 'moved to Wallingford just over a month ago with his wife Raizy and their two young daughters to serve as the directors of the local Chabad-Lubavitch movement'. Its chabad.org listing went up Nov 14 2005. Now 22 South Whittlesey Avenue.

345699.name: Chabad of Westville
345699.note: No start date found yet: Rabbi Chanoch Wineberg's Chabad of Westville, New Haven (69 W Rock Avenue). Its chabad.org listing went up Jan 6 2006, so it existed by then.

529751.name: Chabad of Milford - HCW
529751.note: CrownHeights.info (3 July 2007): 'Rabbi Schneur and Chanie (nee Hecht) Wilhelm of Crown Heights will IYH be moving to Milford, CT where they will establish a new Chabad House.' The New York Times (on CrownHeights.info, 9 Dec 2007): the Hebrew Congregation of Woodmont (built 1926; HCW) hired 'Schneur Wilhelm' 'last spring as the synagogue's first full-time rabbi'. Its chabad.org listing went up July 4 2007. Now 15 Edgefield Avenue.

5186616.name: Cteen of Greater New Haven
5186616.note: No start date found: CTeen of Greater New Haven (Rabbi Shalom Cheruff, Orange). Its chabad.org listing went up July 21 2021, so it existed by then.

5381038.name: Chabad of Downtown New Haven
5381038.note: No start date found yet: Rabbi Mendy Hecht's Chabad of Downtown New Haven (754 Chapel Street). New Haven Independent (1 Dec 2021): a Chabad menorah lighting at Union Station led by Rabbi Hecht. Its chabad.org listing went up Jan 18 2022, so it existed by then.

6567613.name: Young Anash
6567613.note: No start date found: Young Anash, a New Haven synagogue (Rabbi Mendel Prescott). Its chabad.org listing went up Oct 1 2024, so it existed by then.

extra-us-oxford-ct.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Oxford
extra-us-oxford-ct.note: COLlive (28 July 2023): 'Rabbi Shmaya and Hadassa Hecht have been appointed as the new Shluchim to Oxford, Connecticut, marking the opening of the ninth Chabad center in the New Haven region'; it serves 'Oxford, Southbury, Middlebury, Beacon Falls, and Seymour'. Not on chabad.org's directory (an extra center on the map).
